thread:
kevin: Heads upplanning a low-impact "quiet canary" for aurora-7b-quant tomorrow 04:30-05:30 UTC. target: 5% initial, gated ramps. Need fallback ordering change for experimental/dev-only routes and explicit pins for billing/auth.
lina: prefer 5% start, +1 on gates. can you call out the metric deltas that will force rollback?
omar: propose auto-rollback if error_rate > 0.4% OR token_decode_failures > 0.1% OR median latency increase > 20% (10m window). also add KV cache hit-rate watch; quant variant may warm slower.
kevin: agreed. plan: 5% -> 15% hold -> 40% hold -> full. hold durations: 15m at 5%, 20m at 15%. manual ack required at 15%. deploybot hold will be created.
jess: note for product: we'll need a short blurb for the release notes and to mention the experimental tag. product-bot, can you suggest wording?
product-bot: Suggested blurb: "aurora-7b-quant (experimental): quantized variant for lower p95; staged canary; routes tagged 'critical' remain pinned to aurora-7b-fp16."
kevin: ops config snippet (apply to catalog): ```yaml
entry: aurora-7b-quant
fallback_order:
  - aurora-7b-quant
  - aurora-7b-fp16
  - aurora-7b-legacy
tags: ["experimental"]
canary:
  initial: 5
  holds: [15,40]
change_window: "04:30-05:30 UTC"
backstop:
  error_rate_pct: 0.4
  token_fail_pct: 0.1
  median_latency_increase_pct: 20
  eval_window_minutes: 10
pin_policy:
  preserve_for_tags: ["critical","payments"]
```
lina: small tweak: for any route with tag "dev-only" we should route entropy-first to quant variants (to exercise new decoding paths) but for production-critical do not change fallback.
kevin: added entropy-first override for dev-only in the catalog patch. will push as a separate PR.
deploybot: /deploy enable-model aurora-7b-quant --canary=5 --window=2026-04-10T04:30Z/2026-04-10T05:30Z --notify=eng-releases
ops-bot: Reminder: run KV warmup job for aurora-7b-quant before canary start: `/ops kv-warmup aurora-7b-quant --duration=10m`
omar: i'll trigger warmup 10m before start. monitoring checklist: p50/p95/p99, error_rate, token_decode_failures, kv_cache_hit, trace sample rate 100/s. set alert thresholds to backstop values.
jess: posted internal release note draft at https://docs.internal/redwood/releases/aurora-quant-2026 and shared with compliance.
kevin: deploybot scheduled the quiet canary. will announce once live.
deploybot: Canary live  5% traffic at 2026-04-10T04:30:05Z. Observability link: https://telemetry.internal/rollouts/2823456789
omar: initial telemetry: p95 480ms vs baseline 400ms (~20% increase), median steady, error_rate 0.03%, token_fail 0.00%. KV hit-rate 62% (baseline 78%)  acceptable but warming. continuing.
lina: because kv hit-rate low, expect p95 to improve as cache warms. keep the 15m hold to watch trend.
kevin: Hold reached at 15% (manual ack required). tagging @lina @kevin for ack.
lina: manual ack — observed improving trend (p95 down to 430ms, kv hit-rate 70%). approve ramp to 40%.
deploybot: Ramp to 40% complete. Hold at 40% (20m).
omar: monitoring shows p99 spikes during certain prompt patterns; trace samples point to a small attention kernel mismatch in quant path; raising a regression ticket.
kevin: do we cross backstop thresholds? error_rate 0.06% still below 0.4, median latency increase 15% < 20, token_fail 0.05% < 0.1. no auto-rollback.
lina: i'd like a slow steady ramp to full only after the kernel mismatch is triaged. recommend pause at 40% until regression PR lands and we revalidate traces.
\eops: (ops-bot) Note: payments and auth are pinned to aurora-7b-fp16 per policy; nothing changed.
kevin: ok we'll keep 40% paused. deploybot will not continue without manual ack. leaving the thread open.
product-bot: product notified end-users about experimental tag and expected performance variance.
marc: (offline) will join if rollback happens.
kevin: summary: quiet canary started -> 5% -> 15% ack -> 40% paused due to trace regression. pins applied for critical routes. auto-backstop thresholds set. next steps: triage kernel mismatch, update catalog tag post-72h if clean.
